recipes.title: Putt

ingredients.name:
Puttu podi (rice flour) – 2 cups

Fresh grated coconut – 1 cup

Water – as needed

Salt – to taste

recipes.instructions:
1.Take puttu podi in a bowl and add salt.

2.Sprinkle water little by little and mix using fingers.

3.The flour should be moist and crumbly (not dough).

4.Cover and rest the mixture for 10 minutes.

5.In a puttu kutti (puttu maker), add grated coconut at the bottom.

6.Add a layer of prepared rice flour.

7.Repeat layers of coconut and rice flour.

8.Close the puttu maker and steam for 5–7 minutes until steam comes out from the top.

9.Remove from heat and gently push out the puttu.

10.Serve hot with kadala curry

recipes.title: Idali

ingredients.name:
Idli rice – 2 cups

Urad dal (whole or split) – 1 cup

Fenugreek seeds (methi) – ½ tsp

Salt – to taste

Water – as needed

recipes.instructions:
Wash and soak idli rice and fenugreek seeds together for 5–6 hours.

Wash and soak urad dal separately for 4–5 hours.

Grind urad dal to a smooth, fluffy batter using water little by little.

Grind rice to a slightly coarse batter.

Mix both batters together and add salt.

Cover and let the batter ferment overnight (8–10 hours) until it rises.

Grease idli plates lightly with oil.

Pour batter into the moulds.

Steam in an idli cooker for 10–12 minutes.

Remove, cool slightly, and take out the idlis.

recipes.title: Meal

ingredients.name:
Rice – 1 cup

Toor dal – ½ cup

Onion – 1 (chopped)

Green chili – 1

Turmeric powder – ¼ tsp

Salt – to taste

Oil – 1 tbsp

Mustard seeds – ½ tsp

recipes.instructions:
Wash rice and cook with water. Keep aside.

Wash dal and pressure cook with turmeric and water.

Heat oil in a pan.

Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.

Add onion and green chili, sauté lightly.

Add cooked dal, salt, and little water. Boil for 5 minutes.

Serve hot dal with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Biriyani

ingredients.name:
Chicken – 500 g

Onion – 3 (thinly sliced)

Tomato – 2 (chopped)

Ginger-garlic paste – 1½ tbsp

Green chilies – 2 (slit)

Yogurt (curd) – ½ cup

Turmeric powder – ½ tsp

Chili powder – 1 tsp

Coriander powder – 2 tsp

Garam masala – 1 tsp

Biryani masala – 1 tsp

Salt – to taste

Oil + ghee – 4 tbsp total

Mint leaves – handful

Coriander leaves – handful



for rice


Basmati rice – 2 cups

Water – enough

Bay leaf – 1

Cloves – 3

Cardamom – 2

Cinnamon – 1 small stick

Salt – to taste

recipes.instructions:
Wash and soak basmati rice for 30 minutes.

Heat oil and ghee in a deep pan.

Add onions and fry until golden brown.

Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies; sauté well.

Add tomatoes and cook until soft.

Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, biryani masala, garam masala, and salt.

Add chicken and mix well. Cook for 5 minutes.

Add curd, mint, and coriander leaves. Cook until chicken is 70% done.

In another pot, boil water with whole spices and salt.

Add rice and cook till 70% done. Drain water.

Layer rice over chicken masala.

Cover tightly and cook on low flame (dum) for 10–15 minutes.

Switch off flame, rest for 5 minutes, then mix gently.

recipes.title: Pulao

ingredients.name:
Basmati rice – 1 cup

Mixed vegetables (carrot
beans
peas

potato) – 1 cup

Onion – 1 (sliced)

Green chili – 1–2 (slit)

Ginger – 1 tsp (chopped)

Oil or ghee – 2 tbsp

Bay leaf – 1

Cloves – 2

Cardamom – 2

Cinnamon – 1 small piece

Salt – to taste

Water – 2 cups

recipes.instructions:
Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes.

Heat oil or ghee in a cooker or pan.

Add bay leaf, cloves, cardamom, and cinnamon.

Add onion, green chili, and ginger. Sauté till soft.

Add vegetables and salt. Mix well.

Add soaked rice and gently stir.

Pour water and bring to a boil.

Cover and cook:

Cooker: 1 whistle on low flame

Pan: cook covered till rice is done

Switch off flame and rest for 5 minutes.

Fluff gently and serve hot.

recipes.title: Fish curry

ingredients.name:
Fish pieces – 500 g

Onion – 2 (sliced)

Tomato – 1 (chopped)

Ginger-garlic paste – 1 tbsp

Green chili – 1–2 (slit)

Turmeric powder – ½ tsp

Chili powder – 1 tsp

Coriander powder – 2 tsp

Tamarind – small piece (or 1 tbsp tamarind water)

Oil – 2 tbsp

Mustard seeds – ½ tsp

Curry leaves – few

Salt – to taste

Water – as needed

recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pan.

Add mustard seeds; let them splutter.

Add curry leaves and onions. Sauté till soft.

Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies; cook well.

Add tomato and cook till mushy.

Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, and salt.

Add tamarind water and enough water for gravy.

Bring to a boil, then add fish pieces.

Cook on low flame for 8–10 minutes (do not stir too much).

Switch off flame and rest for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chappathi

ingredients.name:
Wheat flour (atta) – 2 cups

Salt – ½ tsp (optional)

Water – as needed

Oil – 1 tsp (optional)

recipes.instructions:
Take wheat flour and salt in a bowl.

Add water little by little and knead into a soft dough.

Add oil and knead again.

Cover and rest the dough for 15–20 minutes.

Make small balls from the dough.

Roll each ball into a thin round chapathi.

Heat a tawa (pan).

Place chapathi on hot tawa; cook till bubbles appear.

Flip and cook the other side till light brown spots.

Remove and serve hot.

recipes.title: Icecream

ingredients.name:
Fresh cream (whipping cream or malai) – 1 cup

Condensed milk – ½ cup

Vanilla essence – 1 tsp

recipes.instructions:
Pour fresh cream into a bowl.

Whip the cream until slightly thick (soft peaks).

Add condensed milk and vanilla essence.

Mix gently until smooth.

Pour into a container and cover tightly.

Freeze for 6–8 hours or overnight.

Scoop and serve cold.

recipes.title: Laddu

ingredients.name:
Besan (gram flour) – 1 cup

Sugar – ¾ cup

Ghee – ½ cup

Cardamom powder – ½ tsp

Cashews / raisins – optional

recipes.instructions:
Heat ghee in a pan on low flame.

Add besan and roast slowly, stirring continuously.

Roast until it turns golden and gives a nice aroma.

Switch off the flame and let it cool slightly.

Add powdered sugar and cardamom powder.

Mix well.

Shape the mixture into small round laddus.

Garnish with nuts if you like.

recipes.title: Halwa

ingredients.name:
Semolina (rava / suji) – 1 cup

Sugar – ¾ cup

Ghee – ½ cup

Water – 2 cups

Cardamom powder – ½ tsp

Cashews & raisins – a handful

recipes.instructions:
Heat ghee in a pan. Add cashews and raisins, fry till golden, then remove and keep aside.

In the same ghee, add semolina and roast on low flame until it turns light golden and gives a nice aroma.

Boil water in another pan. Slowly add it to the roasted semolina, stirring continuously to avoid lumps.

Add sugar and cook until it dissolves and the mixture thickens.

Add cardamom powder and fried nuts. Mix well.

Serve hot.

recipes.title: Appam

ingredients.name:
Raw rice – 1 cup

Cooked rice – ¼ cup

Grated coconut – ½ cup

Yeast – ½ tsp (or baking soda – pinch

optional)

Sugar – 1 tsp

Salt – ½ tsp

Water – as needed

recipes.instructions:
Soak raw rice for 4–5 hours. Drain.

Grind soaked rice with grated coconut and cooked rice into a smooth batter. Add water as needed.

Dissolve yeast in 2 tbsp warm water with sugar. Let it activate for 10 minutes.

Add yeast mixture and salt to the batter. Mix well.

Cover and ferment overnight (or 8–10 hours) until the batter rises.

Heat an appachatti (or small non-stick pan).

Pour a ladle of batter in the center. Tilt the pan to spread thin at edges and keep thick at center.

Cover and cook on medium flame for 2–3 minutes.

The edges should be crisp and center soft. Remove carefully.

Serve hot.

recipes.title: Dosa

ingredients.name:
Rice – 2 cups

Urad dal (split black gram) – ½ cup

Fenugreek seeds – ½ tsp

Salt – to taste

Water – as needed

Oil – for cooking

recipes.instructions:
Wash rice and urad dal separately. Soak rice with fenugreek seeds for 4–5 hours. Soak urad dal separately for 4–5 hours.

Grind urad dal to a smooth, fluffy batter. Grind rice to a slightly coarse batter.

Mix both batters, add salt, and let it ferment overnight (8–10 hours) until it rises.

Heat a non-stick pan or tawa. Spread a little oil.

Pour a ladle of batter in the center. Spread thin in a circular motion.

Drizzle a little oil around the edges. Cook on medium flame until the bottom turns golden brown.

Fold dosa and serve hot.

recipes.title: Sambar rice

ingredients.name:
For Sambar:

Toor dal (pigeon peas) – ½ cup

Tamarind – small lemon-sized ball (or 1 tbsp tamarind paste)

Tomato – 1 (chopped)

Onion – 1 (optional)

Green chili – 1–2

Turmeric powder – ½ tsp

Sambar powder – 1½ tsp

Salt – to taste

Water – 2–3 cups

For Tempering:

Oil – 1 tbsp

Mustard seeds – ½ tsp

Curry leaves – few

Dry red chili – 1

Asafoetida (hing) – a pinch

For Rice:

Cooked rice – 2 cups

recipes.instructions:
Cook Dal: Wash toor dal and cook with turmeric and water until soft. Mash slightly.

Tamarind Water: Soak tamarind in ½ cup water, squeeze and extract juice.

Cook Sambar: In a pan, add cooked dal, tamarind water, chopped tomato, sambar powder, salt, and water. Bring to boil. Simmer for 5–10 minutes.

Tempering: Heat oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, dry red chili, and hing. Pour over sambar.

Combine with Rice: Add cooked rice to the sambar. Mix well.

Serve hot.
